returned_title: Replication Data for: Effectiveness of Incumbent's Strategic Communication during Economic Crisis under Electoral Authoritarianism: Evidence from Turkey
justification: Hosted on Harvard Dataverse, this dataset provides data on the Turkish government's strategic political communication and public messaging during economic events in the late 2010s under the ruling AKP administration.

returned_title: Replication Data for: Politics of Nostalgia and Populism: Evidence from Turkey
justification: Available on Harvard Dataverse, this dataset contains survey data collected in 2017 and 2018 examining Turkish public opinion, political party preferences, and political attitudes towards government and political systems in Turkey.

returned_title: Constitutional Court of Turkey Justice Decisions Dataset
justification: Hosted on Harvard Dataverse, this dataset tracks judicial decisions by the Constitutional Court of Turkey from 1983 through 2011, detailing political party dissolutions, judicial oversight, anti-establishment political parties, and legal governance.

returned_title: Replication Data for: Electoral dynamics, new nationalisms, and party positions on Syrian refugees in Turkey
justification: Hosted on Harvard Dataverse, this dataset provides empirical data on Turkish political party platforms, electoral coalitions, and policy positions during key elections in the 2010s (including the 2018 general elections).

Hosted by the UK Data Service, this national survey includes an International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) module focused on religion, offering dataset measures on religious affiliation, beliefs, church attendance, and moral/social values in Great Britain in 1991.

Archived at the UK Data Service, the 1998 iteration of the survey features the ISSP Religion II module, capturing data on religious practice, faith, spirituality, and social attitudes across Great Britain near the end of the decade.

Maintained by the GESIS Data Archive, this cross-national survey contains representative sample data for Great Britain and Northern Ireland collected in 1990, covering moral standards, social values, religious involvement, and personal beliefs.

Available through the UK Data Service, this survey gathers specific data on religious identity, inter-community relations, political attitudes, and social values within Northern Ireland during the mid-1990s.
Conducted annually in Great Britain, this dataset measures social, moral, political, and economic attitudes, covering core 1990s topics such as civil liberties, welfare, family, and public policy.

Launched in 1991, this major multi-purpose longitudinal dataset tracks British households and individuals over time, capturing social change, economic behavior, and personal attitudes throughout the 1990s.
Part of a continuous survey series running through the 1990s designed to monitor public opinion, political views, and social attitudes across Northern Ireland.

returned_title: British General Election Study, 1992: Cross-Section Survey
justification: This dataset captures public voting choices, political attitudes, party preferences, and evaluations of major policy issues in Great Britain during the 1992 UK General Election.

returned_title: British General Election Study, 1997: Cross-Section Survey
justification: This dataset examines electoral behaviour, political trust, policy preferences, and voter attitudes in Great Britain immediately following the May 1997 UK General Election.
This longitudinal panel dataset tracks changing political attitudes, party alignment, and voting behaviour across individual voters in Great Britain throughout the mid-1990s.
Part of the annual British Social Attitudes series by NatCen, this dataset measures British public opinion and social and political values during the 1990s.
A longitudinal survey preserved by the UK Data Service tracking individual-level changes in political attitudes, party loyalty, and voting behaviour in the UK across the 1992–1997 Parliament.

returned_title: British General Election Study, 1997 : Campaign Panel
justification: Examines political interaction, economic factors, voter choices, and opinions on political leaders and parties during the 1997 UK general election campaign.
Provides national survey data measuring public opinions on political systems, party affiliation, and the role and responsibilities of the UK government in 1990.
The primary dataset series for UK political science research, containing major national election surveys and panel datasets conducted during the 1990s (1992 and 1997).

Initiated in 1991, this longitudinal survey tracked British households and individuals throughout the 1990s, capturing detailed data on occupational social class, household composition, income dynamics, and socio-economic stratification.

Provides comprehensive aggregate population counts and socio-economic metrics across the United Kingdom from the 1991 Census, covering occupational social classes, household structures, and ethnic groupings.

Measures public attitudes and social values across key social groupings in Great Britain at the start of the 1990s, focusing on social class identification, political orientation, welfare policy, and economic inequality.

A foundational UK longitudinal household survey initiated in 1991 that provides detailed annual microdata on individual and household income, employment, expenditure, and socio-economic dynamics throughout the 1990s.

A targeted 1992 national survey dataset from the UK Data Service offering micro-level evidence on labour market structures, employment conditions, work histories, and economic attitudes during the early 1990s UK recession.

returned_title: Bank of England Research Datasets: A Millennium of Macroeconomic Data for the UK
justification: A comprehensive long-run macroeconomic dataset compiled by the Bank of England containing annual, quarterly, and monthly time series on UK GDP, inflation, interest rates, labour metrics, and balance of payments throughout the 1990s.

returned_title: Office for National Statistics: UK Economic Accounts time series
justification: Official time series datasets published by the ONS covering national income, sector accounts, gross domestic product (GDP), and economic growth indicators for the UK spanning the 1990s.

A historical data repository developed jointly by the Economic Statistics Centre of Excellence (ESCoE), ONS, and the Bank of England offering macroeconomic, sectoral, and regional economic statistics for the UK.
Initiated in 1980, ALLBUS provides representative survey data collected biennially on social structures, public attitudes, behavior, and social conditions in West Germany throughout the 1980s.
Launched in 1984, the Socio-Economic Panel is a multidisciplinary longitudinal study tracking household income, employment, living conditions, education, and social indicators in Germany.

returned_title: System of Social Indicators for the Federal Republic of Germany
justification: Maintained by GESIS, this dataset offers quantitative time-series indicators measuring social change, welfare, quality of life, and social conditions in West Germany throughout the 1980s across multiple life domains.

returned_title: Young People and Adults '85 (Shell Youth Survey 1985)
justification: This dataset from the 10th Shell Youth Survey (conducted in 1984/1985 and archived at GESIS) captures the values, interests, future outlook, and social orientation of West German youth during the 1980s.

returned_title: Attitude of Young People to Popular Music 1987
justification: A survey dataset created by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig in 1987, focusing on cultural preferences, life attitudes, and popular music consumption among East German youth in the late 1980s.

returned_title: Schoolchildren Interval Study IS II (Younger Cohort) 1979 - 1985, 6th Wave 1984/85
justification: A longitudinal study dataset managed by GESIS tracking personality development, social behavior, and educational/vocational habits of youth in East Germany between 1979 and 1985.

returned_title: Historical Annual Database - Central Bank of Malta
justification: Published by the Central Bank of Malta, this macroeconomic time-series dataset covers Maltese economic indicators and national accounts from 2000 onwards to address historical series breaks and track economic development.

Provides multi-decade country-level economic and development metrics for Malta, including annual GDP growth, GNI per capita, foreign direct investment, inflation, and structural economic indicators throughout the 2000s.

returned_title: Economy and Growth Indicators for Malta - Humanitarian Data Exchange
justification: Features downloadable time-series data on Malta's economic performance, gross capital formation, adjusted savings, and sectoral value added compiled from World Bank indicators, covering the 2000–2010 decade.

returned_title: Real-Time GDP Database - Central Bank of Malta
justification: Contains dataset vintages of Malta's gross domestic product and major expenditure components, documenting historical economic trends and real-time revisions across the 2000s.

This dataset provides aggregate election returns for Reichstag and Reichspräsident elections, national referenda, and demographic census data (occupations, religion, population) across various administrative levels in the German Reich during 1919–1933.

returned_title: Abgeordnete der Reichstage der Weimarer Republik 1919-1933 (GESIS ZA8007)
justification: Hosted by GESIS, this historical dataset contains collective biographical data, career backgrounds, and parliamentary mandate information for all 1,794 members of the Weimar National Assembly and Reichstag in the German Reich between 1919 and 1933.

returned_title: Wahlen und Abstimmungen in der Weimarer Republik 1919–1933 (GESIS ZA8351)
justification: This GESIS dataset covers electoral outcomes and socio-structural indicators at the electoral district (Wahlkreis) level across the German Reich for all major parliamentary and presidential elections during the Weimar era.

Available on Zenodo, this dataset contains detailed historical records of research applicants, funded projects, and academic history in the German Reich from 1920 to 1945, including data on scientists dismissed or exiled after 1933.

Cross-national survey dataset collected in 1990 covering moral, societal, political, work, and family attitudes and social behaviors across European countries including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland.

Cross-national survey conducted between 1999 and 2001 across European nations that measures public social attitudes, moral values, religious beliefs, family life, and civic participation during the late 1990s.
Cumulated Eurobarometer survey dataset covering European Union member states throughout the 1990s, tracking social attitudes, political values, trust, and demographic characteristics.

returned_title: European Values Study Longitudinal Data File 1981-2008 (EVS 1981-2008)
justification: Integrated longitudinal dataset combining EVS waves from 1981 through 2008, allowing comparative time-series analysis of changing social behavior and basic human values in Western and Northern Europe during the 1990s.

Conducted in early 1996 across EU member states including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland, capturing data on medication and treatment, public health systems, and general health conditions.

Conducted in spring 1998 across EU member states including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland, covering healthcare services, medical treatments, and health safety.

Conducted in late 1996 across EU countries (Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland), documenting personal health practices, medical care, and healthcare policies.

This survey dataset, deposited at GESIS Data Archive and collected on behalf of the European Commission in November 1990, covers self-reported health problems, medical conditions, and diseases across European Community nations (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, and Great Britain/Northern Ireland).

returned_title: Health Survey for England Time Series Dataset, 1991-2009
justification: Hosted by the UK Data Service, this repeated cross-sectional time-series dataset covers Great Britain (England) starting in 1991 throughout the 1990s. It captures health status, chronic illness, and clinical measures, classified under the CESSDA topic 'Specific diseases, disorders and medical conditions'.

Managed by the WHO Regional Office for Europe, this database provides comparative health statistics, disease incidence, mortality, and prevalence data for European countries (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, United Kingdom, Austria, Sweden, and Finland) throughout the 1990s.

This Special Eurobarometer dataset, fielded at the end of the 1990s framework (December 2000), provides cross-national survey data on language skills, native languages, foreign language proficiency, and attitudes toward multilingualism across all 15 EU member states of the era (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland).

Fielded in late 1990, Eurobarometer 34.0 includes a special module on language and linguistics, surveying respondents across EC member countries (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, and Northern Ireland) on foreign language knowledge and language usage.

returned_title: SpeechDat-Car: Large Speech Database for Automotive Environments
justification: Initiated in the 1990s under the European Commission's Language Engineering framework and distributed by ELRA, SpeechDat created large-scale linguistic and speech recognition corpora across European languages (including Danish, English, Finnish, Dutch/Flemish, French, German, Greek, Italian, and Spanish).

The third wave of the European Values Study (1999–2001) covers political behavior, attitudes, civic participation, and social values across European countries, including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Great Britain, Northern Ireland, Austria, Sweden, and Finland during the late 1990s.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES) Module 1 (1996-2001)
justification: CSES Module 1 provides cross-national post-election survey data focusing on political behavior, voter turnout, electoral choices, party identification, and political attitudes across democratic nations (including European states) during the late 1990s.

The 1994 European Election Study (integrated with Eurobarometer 42) measures political attitudes, party choices, trust in political institutions, and electoral participation across EU member states during the 1990s.

returned_title: Das Ruhrgebiet im 19. und 20. Jahrhundert: Bevölkerungsentwicklung, Erwerbstätige, Bergbau und Großeisenindustrie (GESIS ZA8073)
justification: This GESIS historical dataset (HISTAT) compiled by Heinz Günter Steinberg provides time series data on employment, mining, steel production, and heavy industrial development in North Rhine-Westphalia's primary industrial region covering the 1960s.

returned_title: Die regionale Erwerbsstruktur im Deutschen Reich und in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1895–1970 (GESIS ZA8212)
justification: Provides regional employment and labor market time series broken down by economic sector (including industry, trade, and services) specifically for North Rhine-Westphalia from 1895 through 1970.

returned_title: Bruttoverdienste der Arbeiter und Angestellten in Industrie und Handel, Handwerk (GESIS ZA8618)
justification: Contains historical statistical data on gross earnings and labor metrics in industry, trade, and crafts across West Germany, including North Rhine-Westphalia, from 1950 to 2006.
The official statistical database operated by IT.NRW and Open.NRW containing long-term macroeconomic indicators, industrial production figures, and trade statistics for North Rhine-Westphalia.
Central survey dataset from the German Longitudinal Election Study capturing voter behavior, political attitudes, and election results for the 2021 German federal election.
Harmonized municipality-level panel dataset covering vote shares and turnout for federal, state, and local elections in Germany, including elections held in the 2020s.
GESIS dataset focusing on candidate selection and party-internal nomination processes for direct candidates in the 2021 German federal election.

returned_title: Twitter/X accounts of the candidates in the 2023 German state election of Bavaria
justification: Dataset compiled and archived on GESIS documenting social media account details for candidates running in the 2023 Bavarian state election.

returned_title: Twitter accounts of the candidates in the 2023 German state election of Berlin
justification: GESIS dataset collecting candidate digital footprint data for the 2023 Berlin state election.

returned_title: Auswirkungen von Lieferengpässen bei versorgungsrelevanten Medikamenten in Rheinland-Pfalz
justification: An open dataset provided by the Rhineland-Palatinate state data portal tracking supply shortages of essential medications, alternative treatment costs, and therapy options in Rhineland-Palatinate.

returned_title: Das Public Use File des Forschungsdatenzentrum Gesundheit
justification: Public use dataset containing statutory health insurance claims data on medical treatments, hospital stays, and prescription medication across German federal states including Rhineland-Palatinate covering reporting years from 2009 onwards.

returned_title: SEAL Substudy dataset on psychosocial consequences of liver screening
justification: Contains survey and clinical screening data collected between 2018 and 2021 as part of the SEAL population-based screening program for early detection of liver cirrhosis and fibrosis conducted in Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland.
Provides structured epidemiological and clinical datasets on cancer incidence, treatments, and patient outcomes across Rhineland-Palatinate collected continuously throughout the 2000s and 2010s.

An interactive dataset portal managed by the Institute for Digital Health Data RLP that provides aggregated epidemiological and clinical cancer statistics covering over 50 entity groups in Rhineland-Palatinate.

returned_title: Amtliche Statistik der Erwerbstätigkeit in der DDR (HISTAT ZA8078)
justification: Compiled by Wolfgang Fritz and archived at GESIS (HISTAT), this historical dataset contains official statistical time series on employment, labor participation, economic sectors, and occupational breakdowns in the German Democratic Republic (GDR) spanning 1950 to 1989, including detailed data for the 1970s.

returned_title: GDR-Labor Market Report: Long Term Time Series / DDR-Arbeitsmarkt: Langfristige Zeitreihen (HISTAT ZA8189)
justification: Created by Jürgen Wahse and Reinhard Schaefer and hosted on GESIS, this dataset offers 806 statistical time series from 1950 to 1989 on the East German labor market, covering employment levels, qualifications, working hours, and industry sectors throughout the 1970s.

returned_title: Data Fund of Societal Work Power linked with administrative data of the IAB (GAV-ADIAB)
justification: Maintained by the Research Data Centre (FDZ) of the Institute for Employment Research (IAB), this dataset links historical administrative employment records from the East German 'Data Fund of Societal Work Power' (GAV) with longitudinal IAB employment biographies, enabling individual-level analysis of East German worker trajectories.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1971 (4. Welle)
justification: Conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, this survey of East German youth in 1971 collected empirical data on leisure time, cultural interests (literature, film, music, dance), and social participation in the German Democratic Republic during the early 1970s.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This wave of the ZIJ youth longitudinal survey gathered data in 1970 on East German youth, detailing their leisure activities, cultural participation, and interest in arts, music, and literature in the GDR.

returned_title: Suicide, demographic, socio-structural, infrastructure and crime statistics of the German Democratic Republic, 1952 – 1990
justification: This dataset, hosted at GESIS and compiled by Ellen von den Driesch, contains historical health, cause-of-death, suicide, and demographic statistics across districts in the German Democratic Republic covering the entire 1970s period.

returned_title: Human Mortality Database: East Germany (German Democratic Republic) Mortality Data
justification: Provides official historical age- and sex-specific mortality rates, death counts, and life tables compiled from vital registration and census records for East Germany (GDR) spanning 1956 to 1990, including the 1970s.

Maintained by the World Health Organization, this repository includes historic cause-of-death and disease statistics submitted by the German Democratic Republic (GDR) during the 1970s under ICD mortality classifications.

returned_title: The Potsdam Grievance Statistic File (PGSF) - Eingabestatistiken der DDR zwischen 1970 und 1989
justification: Contains dataset records on official complaint statistics ('Eingaben') addressed to municipal, regional, and national government authorities in the German Democratic Republic between 1970 and 1989, documenting political participation and public-administration interactions in the GDR during the 1970s.

returned_title: Characteristics of Political Elites: Long-term Trends in Post-Socialist Central and Eastern Europe
justification: Tracks sociodemographic profiles, educational backgrounds, and office positions of political elites and state/party personnel in post-socialist Central and Eastern Europe, including historical elite structures in the GDR.

returned_title: Resident Population of the German Democratic Republic 1969-1989
justification: Provides administrative population data at county (Kreis), district (Bezirk), and national levels for the GDR from 1969 to 1989 extracted from official Statistical Yearbooks, supporting structural analysis of GDR administrative units and local state governance in the 1970s.

returned_title: Comprehensive Patent Data of the German Democratic Republic (1949-1990)
justification: Captures official patent database records granted by the Office of Inventions and Patents of the GDR from 1949 to 1990, shedding light on state-owned enterprises, research institutes, and central economic administration during the 1970s.

A survey conducted in 1979–1980 by the ZIJ in Leipzig, collecting quantitative data on partnership dynamics, marriage stability, division of household tasks, and family life among young people in the East German socialist state.

Part of a longitudinal interval study series initiated in 1970 in the GDR (with Wave 3 surveyed in 1972). It contains social survey data on youth personal development, family backgrounds, marital aspirations, and living arrangements.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: A longitudinal survey dataset collected in 1970 in the German Democratic Republic by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) Leipzig, examining personality development, social behavior, and life goals among East German youth.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1975 (8. Welle)
justification: Survey data collected in 1975 in East Germany by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ), focusing on youth career choices, work satisfaction, and socialization factors.

returned_title: Parlamentsstudie in Vorbereitung des X. Parlaments der FDJ 1975
justification: Survey dataset conducted in 1975 by the GDR's Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung examining socio-political attitudes and participation of young people ahead of the Free German Youth (FDJ) parliament.

returned_title: Young People and Health 1973 (Jugend und Gesundheit 1973)
justification: Empirical survey dataset from 1973 conducted by the GDR's Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung investigating health habits, lifestyle, and living conditions of East German youth.

returned_title: Human Fertility Database (HFD) - Germany Country Series
justification: Maintained by the Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and the Vienna Institute of Demography, this open-access database provides standardized historical demographic datasets on age-specific fertility rates, live birth counts, and cohort fertility for West Germany, East Germany, and unified Germany during the 1970s.

Managed by the Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and the Vienna Institute of Demography, HFC offers supplementary historical fertility estimates, survey data, and age-specific birth data covering East and West Germany during the 1970s.

returned_title: Sociological Problems of a Special Epidemiology of HIV Infections 1989
justification: This GESIS dataset (ZA6890) contains survey and epidemiological research data on HIV/AIDS in the German Democratic Republic (GDR), collected in 1989 by the Institute for Sociology and Social Policy and the Central Institute for Hygiene, Microbiology, and Epidemiology of the GDR.

returned_title: Suicide, demographic, socio-structural, infrastructure and crime statistics of the German Democratic Republic, 1952 – 1990
justification: This dataset provides official, previously confidential annual statistics on suicides—a major cause of death and mental health indicator—along with demographic and socio-structural data in the German Democratic Republic, covering the period from 1952 to 1990 including the entire 1980s.

Eurostat's harmonized enterprise-level survey launched in 1992 (CIS 1) and 1996/1997 (CIS 2) covers business innovation, organizational restructuring, management strategies, and industrial practices across European countries including Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain during the 1990s.

Distributed via the UK Data Service, this microdataset provides representative data on workplace organization, human resource management practices, employee consultation, and industrial relations across business establishments in Great Britain in 1998.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 44.3OVR: Second European Survey on Working Conditions (1996)
justification: Commissioned by Eurofound and archived at GESIS, this dataset surveyed employees and workplaces in 1996 across EU member states (including Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain), measuring work organization, structural job characteristics, and workplace management practices.
This enterprise-level dataset hosted by the UK Data Service tracks business management, organizational practices, innovation investments, and firm strategy starting from its 1994 wave.

Conducted by Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics (formerly the Federal Office of Statistics), this household survey provides microdata on household composition, income, consumption patterns, and living conditions across urban and rural sectors, including Lagos State in 1980.

returned_title: Atlas of Urban Expansion - Lagos Dataset
justification: Provides spatial, demographic, and density datasets documenting urban growth, land cover changes, and suburban vs. rural built-up area transitions in Lagos starting from 1984.

returned_title: USGS EarthExplorer - Historical Landsat Imagery for Lagos (1980s)
justification: Hosts Landsat satellite imagery datasets covering Lagos during the 1980s, enabling researchers to map historical urban sprawl, land use changes, and peri-urban rural transformations.

returned_title: IPUMS DHS - Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys
justification: Provides harmonized survey data covering household demographics, urban/rural residence, fertility, and community health indicators in Nigeria, including regional coverage for Lagos.

returned_title: The German Local Population Database (GPOP), 1871 to 2019
justification: A comprehensive database providing local population statistics for all municipalities, counties, and states in Germany, including historical census data for 1871 and 1910 during the German Empire period.

returned_title: Grunddaten der Bevölkerungsstatistik Deutschlands von 1871 bis 1939 (GESIS ZA8295)

returned_title: MPIDR Census Mosaic: German Empire Historical GIS Datafiles
justification: Provides historical GIS shapefiles and administrative boundary datasets for the German Empire (1871–1945), capturing annual changes in regional and state administrative divisions throughout the 1870s to 1910s.

returned_title: Chronicling Germany: An Annotated Historical Newspaper Dataset
justification: A digital history dataset containing layout and text annotations for historical German-language newspapers published between 1852 and 1924, covering press and media history throughout the German Empire.

This dataset (GESIS ZA2653) investigates the transformation of housing environments, local community structures, and urban living conditions across selected East German municipal districts following the collapse of the GDR during the early 1990s transition period.
Conducted in the early 1990s, this dataset (GESIS ZA2425) documents the urban and rural background, housing situations, community mobility, and integration experiences of former GDR citizens.

This dataset (GESIS ZA6413) provides quantitative records of public grievances (Eingaben) submitted by GDR citizens between 1970 and 1989, documenting quality of life, local community issues, and urban/rural infrastructure problems across East German municipalities.

This longitudinal panel dataset (GESIS ZA6213 et seq.) tracks East German youth from late GDR times (1987) through the 1990s transition, surveying local community integration, political attitudes, and changing urban and rural living conditions in Saxony.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Relations and Support Systems / Social Networks II - ISSP 2001

It covers social relations, networks, and social stratification indicators collected in 2001 across all 28 requested countries/territories: Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, New Zealand, Northern Ireland, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Russian Federation, Slovenia, Spain, South Africa, Switzerland, and the United States of America.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Inequality IV - ISSP 2009
justification: This cross-national survey dataset from the ISSP (GESIS study ZA5400) investigates social inequality, class stratification, social mobility, wage equity, and group conflicts across participating nations during 2000s (specifically fielded 2008–2010), including Australia, Austria, Canada, Chile, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, New Zealand, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Russian Federation, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, and the United States of America.

A four-wave panel dataset (2013–2018) tracking early integration processes, socio-economic status, demographic background, and living conditions of recent immigrants to the Netherlands during the 2010s.

returned_title: CBS StatLine - External migration; sex, age, marital status and country of birth (03742eng)
justification: Official Statistics Netherlands dataset providing annual data on international immigration, emigration, and net migration flow parameters across the 2010s disaggregated by country of birth, age, sex, and marital status.

returned_title: CBS StatLine - Population; sex, age, generation and migration background (37325)
justification: Statistics Netherlands historical demographic dataset documenting the resident population by migration background, migration generation, age, and sex covering 1996 to 2022.
Key population statistics published by Statistics Netherlands detailing net migration, population growth, and origin composition throughout the 2010s.
A representative longitudinal household survey initiated in West Germany in 1984, providing microeconomic time series on income, employment, living standards, and labor dynamics during the 1980s.

returned_title: Long Time Series on Economic Development in Germany (Deutsche Bundesbank)
justification: Provides official macroeconomic historical time series for Germany covering the 1980s, including national accounts, inflation rates, interest rates, money supply, and international trade balances.

returned_title: histat - Time Series on Historical Statistics of Germany
justification: A repository managed by the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE containing historical quantitative time-series datasets on economic development, sector output, and social statistics in West and East Germany throughout the 1980s.

Initiated in 1991, this nationally representative UK longitudinal survey collected detailed annual household and individual data on marriage, cohabitation, family formation, and household relationships throughout the 1990s.

This 1994 iteration of the British Social Attitudes survey featured an International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) module specifically focused on attitudes towards family life, marriage, and changing gender roles in Great Britain.

Surveys voters across European Union member states in 1994 (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, and Great Britain/Northern Ireland) on international politics, European integration, foreign policy attitudes, and EP election participation.

Provides quantitative content-analytical data of electoral manifestos for political parties across democratic nations, including all 15 EU member states throughout the 1990s, tracking party positions on internationalism, European integration, peace, and international organisations.

Offers annual country-level political, institutional, and policy indicators for 36 OECD/EU democratic countries (including all requested European nations) for the 1990s, covering government composition, EU integration, and macro-political variables.

returned_title: EU Policy Agendas Project Dataset (Comparative Agendas Project)
justification: Tracks political agendas, policy priorities, and decision-making attention in European Union institutions and member states during the 1990s using standardized Comparative Agendas Project topic codes.

returned_title: Erwerbstätige nach Wirtschaftsbereichen auf dem Gebiet des heutigen NRW, 1850 bis 1970
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (Study ZA8685) provides historical statistics on the distribution of employed persons across economic sectors for cities and districts in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW) from 1850 through 1970, including the full decade of the 1960s.
This GESIS HISTAT dataset (Study ZA8686) contains workplace census data on employment within manufacturing and industrial sectors for North Rhine-Westphalia from 1850 to 1970.

returned_title: Erwerbstätigkeitsstatistik in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland: Ausgewählte Daten von 1950 bis 2000
justification: This GESIS HISTAT data compilation (Study ZA8184) presents official West German employment statistics and Microcensus time series broken down by federal states, covering employment in North Rhine-Westphalia throughout the 1960s.

Provides a digitized full-text search corpus of major East German daily newspapers ('Neues Deutschland', 'Berliner Zeitung', and 'Neue Zeit') spanning 1945/1946 to 1990/1994, capturing East German press and state media throughout the 1970s.

A 1973 empirical survey dataset conducted by the GDR's Central Institute for Youth Research (Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung), capturing media consumption, leisure habits, and cultural involvement of East German youth in the 1970s.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen (GDR Television Audience Reaction Series)
justification: A series of sociological research datasets produced by the State Committee for Television (Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen) measuring television viewing habits, program ratings, and viewer engagement in the German Democratic Republic.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: Conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, this survey measures political attitudes, ideology, and social behavior among young citizens in East Germany in 1970.

returned_title: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS 1 - 1977 (10. Welle - Querschnitt)
justification: Part of the ZIJ longitudinal study series, this 1977 cross-sectional wave captures political attitudes, social behavior, and civic/political orientations of youth in the GDR during the late 1970s.

returned_title: The Potsdam Grievance Statistic File (PGSF) - Eingabestatistiken der DDR zwischen 1970 und 1989
justification: This dataset records political participation, quality-of-life concerns, and citizen complaints submitted through the GDR's official petitioning system ('Eingaben') across districts and counties continuously from 1970 to 1989.
